sources.label: GRETIL
sources.name: Göttingen Register of Electronic Texts in Indian Languages
sources.credit: Text from GRETIL, the Göttingen Register of Electronic Texts in Indian Languages, maintained by the Göttingen State and University Library (SUB Göttingen), and its contributors named in the edition details.
sources.terms: Licence as stated in each text; most are licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

sources.label: DSBC
sources.name: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon
sources.credit: Text from the Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC), a project of the University of the West with the Nagarjuna Institute, Kathmandu, and the input and proof-reading staff named in the edition details.
sources.terms: For non-commercial educational and research use, under the DSBC usage policy.

sources.label: SARIT
sources.name: Search and Retrieval of Indic Texts
sources.credit: Text from SARIT (Search and Retrieval of Indic Texts), a library of TEI-encoded Indic texts developed with funding from the German Research Foundation (DFG) and the US National Endowment for the Humanities (NEH), with the editors and the data-entry and encoding contributors named in the edition details.
sources.terms: Licence as stated in each text: CC BY-SA 4.0 or 3.0 (attribution and share-alike). Changes made in converting it are listed in the edition details.

sources.label: Archive Nepal
sources.name: Archive Nepal: Nepalbhasa manuscripts
sources.credit: Text from the Nepalbhasa manuscripts collection of Archive Nepal, digitised with UNESCO and the Asha Archives. Archive Nepal stores the manuscripts on Wikisource, where volunteers transcribed them; some pages are unproofread automatic transcription, and the proofreading levels are given in the edition details.
sources.terms: The transcriptions are on Wikisource under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike licence (CC BY-SA 4.0).

sources.label: Nāgārjuna editions
sources.name: Critical editions of works of Nāgārjuna (Ye Shaoyong; Li Xuezhu; Phurtsham; Yonezawa)
sources.publisher: Zhongxi Book Company; Tibetan Classics Publishing House; Naritasan Institute for Buddhist Studies
sources.credit: Sanskrit text of the critical editions by Ye Shaoyong (Mūlamadhyamakakārikā, 2011) and Li Xuezhu and Ye Shaoyong (Yuktiṣaṣṭikākārikā, 2014) in the Sanskrit–Tibetan–Chinese Buddhist Texts Series (Zhongxi Book Company, Shanghai), and by Phurtsham (Ratnāvalī, Tibetan Classics Publishing House, Lhasa), and the transliteration of the Vigrahavyāvartanī manuscript by Yoshiyasu Yonezawa (Journal of the Naritasan Institute for Buddhist Studies 31, 2008). The readings are the work of the editors; the Tibetan and Chinese texts, translations, notes and apparatus are not reproduced.
sources.terms: The editions are in copyright; the Sanskrit text is offered for research and study. Cite the printed editions.

sources.label: ARIRIAB
sources.name: Annual Report of the International Research Institute for Advanced Buddhology (ARIRIAB) and St Petersburg Sanskrit Fragments
sources.publisher: International Research Institute for Advanced Buddhology, Soka University
sources.credit: Sanskrit text transcribed from an edition in the Annual Report of the International Research Institute for Advanced Buddhology at Soka University (ARIRIAB) or in St Petersburg Sanskrit Fragments I. The readings are the work of the editor named in the edition details; the edition's introduction, translation, notes and apparatus are not reproduced.
sources.terms: The editions are © IRIAB, Soka University, and their authors. The transcriptions are offered for research and study; cite the printed edition.

sources.label: BDRC
sources.name: Buddhist Digital Resource Center e-texts
sources.credit: Text from the e-texts published by the Buddhist Digital Resource Center (BDRC) as open data in OpenPecha-Data. The original collection (GRETIL, DSBC or another), editor and input details are given in the edition details.
sources.terms: BDRC publishes its e-texts as open data; the original collection's terms apply to the text.

sources.label: Schøyen
sources.name: Buddhist Manuscripts in the Schøyen Collection
sources.credit: Text transcribed from an edition in Buddhist Manuscripts in the Schøyen Collection (general editor Jens Braarvig; Hermes Publishing, Oslo). The readings and restorations are the work of the editor named in the edition details; the edition's introduction, notes, parallel texts and translation are not reproduced.
sources.terms: The edition is in copyright, all rights reserved. The transcription is offered for research and study; no licence is granted. Cite the printed edition.
